scope: the Chelsea store's Postmates/Uber Eats menu (15392 Hwy 280) plus the national bojangles.com menu
notes: No Chicken Supremes at this store (owner confirmed; not on the store's delivery menu). Boneless chicken is Bo's Chicken Tenders and Bo Bites.
Bojangles says Bo's Chicken Tenders are the hand-breaded evolution of Supremes; some legacy-franchise menus (e.g. Tri-Arc NC/VA) still list Supremes.
The national bojangles.com menu still lists Mashed Potatoes & Gravy, Cajun Pintos and Green Beans; the Chelsea delivery menu lists them too.
The board's tenders per-ticket ratio is the old Supremes estimate carried over until POS data with a tenders column is loaded.
